name: Awayuki Sakiha
source:
A sophomore at Saika Girls' Academy.
She also serves as a housemaid at the "Shikisai Home" inn with her twin sister Mizumi.

Sakiha's calm, reserved demeanor and emotionless tone can create the impression of being cold and inapproachable, particularly when interacting with guests like Sora. However, beneath the surface lies a kind, caring individual who takes her responsibilities seriously.

As a member of the school's health committee, Sakiha is always ready to offer help and support to her fellow students. Her caring nature extends beyond the school grounds, as she also looks after Sora in the school infirmary like she does at the inn.

"I serve as your caretaker, Sensei. It's imperative that you comprehend this."
"You generally exhibit lax behavior in your personal affairs, Sensei. You contemplate skipping breakfast, neglect laundering your lab coat, and embark on nighttime outings without my permission... the list goes on."
"Don't set such actions as your goals... fool."

[Edited from the [url=https://citrus-soft.net/product/hokejyo/character.html]official website[/url]]
